name: app.provanza/public-delivery-evidence
title: Provanza delivery evidence
description: Look up public carrier evidence guidance and run a fictional proof-of-delivery demo.

tools.name: lookup_carrier_evidence
tools.description: Look up a documented carrier, market, and service example. Returns the issuer, evidence provenance, input requirements, availability guidance, and sources. The directory does not determine whether a particular shipment has proof.

tools.name: run_fictional_pod_demo
tools.description: Replay a fixed fictional batch and return the three outcomes, the public fixture URL, and the marked sample PDF URL. Creates no shipment requests or charges.
